description: Beta patch: dispatch channel runtime agent definitions, refresh registry-backed spec via update, add Reasonix platform support, ship session-insight bundled skill, and rename spec-bootstarp → spec-bootstrap.
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- feat(cli): `memerig init` and `memerig update` now ship `.memerig/agents/{check,implement}.md`, so switching to a channel-driven workflow no longer fails with "Agent 'check' not found" (#323).
- feat(cli): `memerig update` refreshes registry-backed `.memerig/spec` templates through the existing hash/conflict flow. `memerig init --template <id>` persists the spec source/template in `.memerig/config.yaml` so subsequent updates can re-fetch it. Supports direct spec registries and marketplace-style registries (#324).
- feat(platform): add **Reasonix** (DeepSeek-Reasonix) as the 15th supported AI coding tool via `memerig init --reasonix`. Subagent skills (`memerig-implement`, `memerig-check`) carry `runAs: subagent` frontmatter so Reasonix spawns them as isolated subagent loops (#301).
- feat(skills): bundle `session-insight` skill that teaches the AI how and when to reach for `memerig mem` to recall past conversations across Claude Code and Codex sessions. Auto-dispatched to every supported platform on init/update.
- feat(workflow): `memerig workflow --template <id>` and `memerig init --workflow <id>` print a stderr warning when the resolved workflow references `.memerig/agents/<name>.md` files that are missing on disk, pointing the user at `memerig update`.

**Bug Fixes:**
- fix(skills): rename bundled `spec-bootstarp` → `spec-bootstrap` (typo). `memerig update --migrate` ships a `rename-dir` migration that renames the installed directory across 13 platform skill roots; missing roots are silently skipped. Historical migration manifests `0.5.17.json` and `0.6.0-beta.18.json` keep the typoed text because they describe what already shipped to users on those versions (#296).

notes: Beta patch on top of 0.6.0-beta.22. Run `memerig update --migrate` to rename installed `spec-bootstarp/` skill directories to `spec-bootstrap/` across every platform you have configured (silently skips ones you do not). Plain `memerig update` also installs the new `session-insight` bundled skill and the `.memerig/agents/{check,implement}.md` channel runtime files.
